Application Data.NAME: Greenscape Landscaping Ltd.
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, 123 Greenway Drive, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, (555) 123-4567
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Greenscape Landscaping Ltd. specializes in providing comprehensive garden and landscaping services, including lawn maintenance, landscape design, planting of trees and shrubs, installation of hardscapes, and irrigation system setup. Our team is dedicated to enhancing outdoor spaces for both residential and commercial clients, ensuring that each project is tailored to meet the unique needs of our customers. We prioritize sustainable practices and use eco-friendly materials wherever possible to promote healthy, vibrant landscapes. Our services also include seasonal clean-up, pest control, and ongoing landscape management to maintain the beauty and health of our clients' properties year-round.
